info.title: FleetFuel Portal API
info.description: REST API of the FleetFuel Portal, a fictional portfolio project. Operations with x-status "implemented" are served and checked against real responses by tests/Feature/Api/OpenApiContractTest.php and the per-endpoint API tests; x-abilities (all required) and x-any-abilities (at least one required) and x-roles are compared with the route middleware. Operations with x-status "planned" are not routed yet (reports and exports in M08). Business details: docs/04-BUSINESS-RULES.md and docs/05-API-CONTRACT.md.

patch.summary: Admin or own manager updates quotas/status
patch.description: A nonempty subset of monthly_limit_l, monthly_limit_usd (decimal strings, null = unlimited) and status (active or blocked), applied together under the card lock and audited. A limit may drop below this month's usage. Ownership, assignment and card number cannot change here (422). Archived cards are final: 409 invalid_transition. An inactive company's limits cannot change and its cards cannot be unblocked: 403 company_inactive. Another company's card is 404.

post.description: Creates a pending diesel order and its initial null -> pending history row; no card, quota or ledger change. Admin must send company_id (an active company); a manager must omit it. liters is a positive decimal string; preferred_start_at and preferred_end_at are offset-bearing instants, the start in the future (at most 366 days ahead) and the end after the start. status, truck, delivery time, price or any other field is refused (422). A manager of an inactive company gets 403 company_inactive.

patch.description: expected_status is the status the caller last saw; status is the target. The order row is locked, then: a company manager may only ask for pending -> cancelled on their own order (anything else 403 forbidden); if the order is no longer in expected_status the change is refused with 409 stale_state (details.current_status); a skipped step, the same status again or any move out of delivered/cancelled is 409 invalid_transition. Scheduling needs scheduled_start_at (future, at most 366 days ahead), scheduled_end_at (after the start) and assigned_truck; cancelling needs reason; these fields are refused for other targets (422). delivered_at is set from server time. Each accepted change writes one history row and one audit row in the same transaction. Token: an admin needs deliveries:status, a company manager deliveries:write; the route accepts either and the request checks the one the role needs (403).
